audience: membership organisations, clubs and associations that manage members and events in Raklet

useCases.title: Find a member and read the full record
useCases.text: List the contacts one page at a time. Then read one contact's addresses, emails, phones, education and work history. List the tags to find a group.

useCases.title: Check membership payments and debts
useCases.text: List which contact holds which membership plan, the payments recorded, and the debts a contact still owes.

useCases.title: Review events and their ticket options
useCases.text: List events in a date range. Open one event and read the prices and types of its ticket options.

useCases.title: Review applications and the action log
useCases.text: List membership application submissions. Read the action log to see who changed what and when, filtered by date or contact.

useCases.title: Add a new member contact
useCases.text: List the language codes Raklet accepts, then create a contact. Raklet may send the contact an e-mail, depending on the organisation's settings.

useCases.title: Create a news post for the community feed
useCases.text: List the existing news posts, then create a new one. Read the status in the reply to see whether it is a draft or published.
